reviews.title: Great cost efficient nvme drive
reviews.comment:
I picked up the Addlink G55 1TB to upgrade my gaming rig and was honestly blown away by the performance, especially for the price. I was a bit skeptical at first since it's not one of the "big name" brands, but it delivered PCIe Gen 5 speeds that are right up there with the much more expensive drives.
Installation was super easy, and the drive was recognized right away. I tested it on a PCIe 4.0 board and still got read speeds close to 7000MB/s, which is more than enough for gaming, video editing, or just fast boot times.
One thing to note: this model doesn’t come with a heatsink. It runs fine for everyday use, but if you’re planning to do a lot of large file transfers or heavy workloads, you might want to add a heatsink or get the G55H version.
Overall, this is a solid SSD that gives you top-tier performance without the premium price. Would definitely buy again
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: Blazing Fast Storage With a Premium Price Tag
reviews.comment: I installed this drive in my gaming rig and the speed difference was immediately noticeable — games load almost instantly and video editing projects render much faster. It runs cool even without a heatsink, which surprised me since most high‑end drives get hot. My kids love that Minecraft worlds pop up in seconds now, though I did notice the cost is higher than other SSDs with slightly lower speeds. For anyone who wants cutting‑edge performance without worrying about overheating, it’s a solid choice, but definitely more of an investment than budget options.
reviews.author: Dove
